Name: Mighty Nein in Stardew Valley - Patched
Author: goatman14
Description:
[b]Updates for new 1.6 content are on their way, slowly but surely.[/b]

This is an updated version of the wonderful [i]Mighty Nein in Stardew Valley[/i] made by calicoJill. The original mod is incompatible with Stardew Valley game versions since 1.5.1, and is buggy in some earlier versions (1.4.5), and I didn't want this mod to be inaccessible for everyone playing up-to-date versions of Stardew Valley.

As of mod version 3.1.0, all sprites and portraits for content added since game version 1.4 have been updated. Much of the new dialogue, however, has not yet been modified to fit the tone of the Mighty Nein characters (although names have been substituted as needed). This should primarily affect late-game content.

The most likely issues that may arise with this version will be graphical glitches, so please let me know if any items/people look odd (or don't appear at all), as well as any crashes or other bugs you may experience.

Also available [b][url=https://github.com/fraxinus-excelsior/MightyNeinSV][b]on github[/b][/url][/b]


[b]Original mod:[/b] [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3983]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3983[/url]

[b]From the original description[/b]

This content patch will replace NPC's with members of the Mighty Nein. The list includes
Fjord (Alex overhaul)
Beau (Abigail overhaul)
Caleb (Shane overhaul)
Nott (Jas overhaul)
Jester (Emily overhaul)
Molly (Sebastian overhaul)
Caduceus (Elliott overhaul)
Yasha (Leah overhaul)

It changes, portraits, sprites, dialogue, likes, events and even some quests to be more character specific to the Mighty Nein.

It also includes additional hairstyles and an altered skin colour file to allow you to make a member of the Mighty Nein as your player character.

NOTE: If you choose to play as a member of the Mighty Nein, you may need to set the hair option to white in order for it to display properly as I had to colour the hair texture in order to give it variation. IE: Blue ribbon in Beau's brown hair, Nott's mask along with her ears, Gold and silver on Molly's horns.
Also be aware that in playing as a member of the Mighty Nein you will have a twin in town somewhere as I wasn't about to make 8 variations of the same mod seeing as changing one character isn't as simple as replacing a name, sprite and portrait. It involves editing dozens of events and dialogues and assets in order to catch any discrepancies.
